newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Motta favors sale of Telebras with A Band.
newsitem.headline: Motta favors sale of Telebras with A Band.

text.p: Brazilian Communications Minister Sergio Motta said Tuesday he was against selling the A Band cellular services of federally owned Telebras separately from the system's conventional services.
But Motta said the issue was still under study and the A Band operations might yet be sold in advance of the rest of Telebras.
"I would only give up my position...if the (Telebras) privatization timetable implied a reduction in the value of A Band," the minister told a news conference.

The Communications Ministry has been split over the question of the A Band services. Selling them along with regional units of Telebras' conventional network would increase the value of those units at auction.
